name: Richard Friend

summary.text: Richard Friend is a retired project manager with an associate degree in welding and fabrication. He said he has no connection to the university.

experience.text: Retired project manager; associate degree in welding and fabrication.

education_focus.text: Friend says his priorities are reducing the size of government 'in all phases,' shifting CU spending 'more in line with education and less on CU football,' and bringing 'more bipartisanship to the board.'
On artificial intelligence, he says 'AI should not be allowed in classrooms.'
On affordability, he says CU should 'accept most qualified students regardless of family income.'
